epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce full stack startup time to under 1 minute
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml to the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml, so that the full stack can be launched locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local development environment, When the user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When the health-check endpoint is queried, Then it returns a success response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local startup configuration time to zero

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Implement update and delete actions in the existing UI to call existing PUT and DELETE endpoints.

slices.title: Add update and delete actions to material UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions to the UI, so that the catalog accurately reflects current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user clicks edit and saves changes, Then the frontend calls the PUT endpoint and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete, Then the frontend calls the DELETE endpoint and removes it from the view.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material deletion time from undefined to < 5 seconds

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication for accessing the catalog or creating a material, blocking unauthenticated users and prompting them to log in.

slices.title: Implement standard authentication mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce standard authentication, so that restricted data is protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authentication coverage to 100% for restricted endpoints
